subject: Change class attributes inside an observer

messages.author: 26654b4f92bd548a
messages.subject: Change class attributes inside an observer
parts:
Hi folks

I made a nice app (thanks Shiny developers!) that is very general in use so that it's independent on the uploaded dataset. All menus are populated after the dataset is uploaded (see the updateSelectInput() down here for example). 
I cannot wrap my head around a stable solution to the following problem: I need to be able to change class() to some variables, which of these exactly, obviously I don't know before uploading the dataset.

observe({
    file1 = input$dataset
    if(is.null(input$dataset)){  #This tells the App to wait...
      return(NULL)
    }
    df = read_sas(file1$datapath) # ...until there is a dataset
    
    class(df[["year"]]) <- "character"  # THIS WORKS OK if you know which column to change but it's not generally valid, 
                                                        # i.e. this example requires the user to know "year" is the variable which will be read 
                                                        # as numeric, but needs to be transformed to "character" or "factor"
    
    categ = reactive({names(df[sapply(df, is.character)])})
    updateSelectInput(session, "varinput", choices = c("None", categ()), selected ="None")
    
    etcetc...

 If I find a way to generalize the assignment of a class() to any variable of the user's choosing, my App will be 100% complete. I'd love to hear your thoughts.
